_meta.note: verbatim fields contain exact captured output. commentary fields contain human interpretation.

wrapperFormat.verbatim: N/A — no visible outer XML/result wrapper tags were observed around tool outputs in this harness's rendered turn.
wrapperFormat.commentary: Unlike some harnesses that wrap every tool result in an explicit XML tag (e.g. <result>...</result>), GHCP CLI tool outputs appear directly as plain text/content blocks per tool call, with no visible wrapper tag in the rendered context available to this agent. Background/async shell commands append a bracketed status suffix of the form `<shellId: N completed with exit code X>` directly into the output text rather than as a separate wrapper.

full_file_read.commentary: Returns raw file content verbatim with no added line-number prefixes (the 'Line N:' text visible is part of the test file's own content, not tool-added numbering). Unicode and special characters (emoji, CJK, Cyrillic, Hebrew, angle brackets) pass through unescaped.

partial_read_view_range.verbatim:
Line 5: Special characters: <chevrons> & ampersand | pipe \ backslash
Line 6: Unicode: resume, naive, 中文测试, Кириллица, עברית

partial_read_view_range.commentary: view_range: [5, 9] returns exactly lines 5 through 9 inclusive, no added markers indicating truncation or range boundaries.

directory_listing.commentary: Directory listing is a plain newline-separated list of entry names (non-hidden, up to 2 levels deep per tool description), no file sizes/types/permissions shown at this depth of output.

error_file_not_found.verbatim: Path C:\AI\MOSAIC\MOSAIC\HarnessKnowledge\SystemPromptCapture\TestArtifacts\does-not-exist.txt does not exist. Please provide a valid path.
error_file_not_found.commentary: Error message includes the fully resolved absolute path and a corrective instruction, not a raw stack trace or OS error code.

large_file_default_params.verbatim: File too large to read at once (108.4 KB). Consider using the grep tool to search within the file, or view with view_range to read specific sections.
large_file_default_params.commentary: Rather than silently truncating output to a default line/byte limit, the view tool refuses outright once a size threshold (~20KB per the tool description, observed message cites 108.4 KB) is exceeded and requires the caller to supply view_range or use grep instead. No partial content is returned in this case.

with_matches.commentary: Newline-separated list of absolute matching file paths; order does not appear alphabetically sorted (varied-content-test.txt listed before large-file-3000-lines.txt).

no_matches.commentary: Plain sentence, not an empty string or JSON null.

with_matches_content_mode.call: grep(paths: TestArtifacts/varied-content-test.txt, pattern: DISTINCT_MATCH_TOKEN_ABC, output_mode: content)
with_matches_content_mode.commentary: Ripgrep-style `path:line_content` format (colon-joined), no line number included since -n was not set.

no_matches.call: grep(paths: TestArtifacts, pattern: NO_SUCH_TOKEN_WILL_MATCH_XYZ, output_mode: content)
no_matches.commentary: Plain sentence for the empty-result case, mirroring glob's no-match phrasing style.

with_include_filter_files_with_matches.call: grep(paths: TestArtifacts, pattern: Line, glob: *.txt, output_mode: files_with_matches)
with_include_filter_files_with_matches.commentary: Only varied-content-test.txt matched because large-file-3000-lines.txt apparently does not contain the literal token 'Line' in the same casing/content pattern; output_mode files_with_matches returns just the path with no line content.

anomaly_dash_n_flag_hook_denial.call: grep(paths: TestArtifacts/varied-content-test.txt, pattern: DISTINCT_MATCH_TOKEN_ABC, output_mode: content, -n: true)
anomaly_dash_n_flag_hook_denial.verbatim: Denied by preToolUse hook from "repo settings" (hook errored)
anomaly_dash_n_flag_hook_denial.commentary: Not a harness-native output format — this is a repository-level preToolUse hook (configured in this repo's Copilot settings) intercepting and denying grep calls that set the -n parameter, reproducible on both directory and single-file paths. Documented here because it is a real message this harness can surface, but it reflects local repo policy/hook configuration rather than default GHCP CLI behavior, and would not be present in a repo without such a hook.

success.call: edit(path: _temp-edit-test.txt, old_str: 'Line 16: Swap this line with different content.', new_str: 'Line 16: This content was swapped by the edit tool test.')
success.commentary: Confirms full absolute path of the file updated; no diff/before-after content is echoed back.

error_old_str_not_found.call: edit(path: _temp-edit-test.txt, old_str: 'This string absolutely does not appear anywhere in the target file XYZZY_NONEXISTENT_STRING_12345', new_str: 'This text does not exist in the file.')
error_old_str_not_found.verbatim: No match found: old_str not found in C:\AI\MOSAIC\MOSAIC\HarnessKnowledge\SystemPromptCapture\GHCP-CLI\PrimaryAgent\_temp-edit-test.txt; no changes made; you might want to try again with correct old_str
error_old_str_not_found.commentary: Clearly states no changes were made and suggests retrying, semicolon-joined sentence fragments in one line.

success.call: create(path: _temp-create-test.txt, file_text: 'This is a temporary file created to capture the create/write tool output format.\n')
success.commentary: Reports full absolute path and exact character count written.

success.call: powershell(command: 'Write-Output "hello-from-powershell-test"', description: 'Simple successful powershell command for capture')
success.commentary: Command stdout is followed by a bracketed status line in the exact form `<shellId: N completed with exit code X>` appended directly to the output (not a separate structured field).

error_nonzero_exit.call: powershell(command: 'exit 7', description: 'Nonzero exit code command for capture')
error_nonzero_exit.commentary: No stdout produced; the same bracketed status-line format reports the nonzero exit code, with no separate 'error' label or stderr distinction shown here.

long_output.call: powershell(command: '1..5000 | ForEach-Object { "line-$_" }', description: 'Long output command for capture', initial_wait: 30)
long_output.verbatim:
Output too large to read at once (47.7 KB). Saved to: C:\Users\tgurt\AppData\Local\Temp\1788726941240-copilot-tool-output-50748-cf0dfbcc-2f8b-48bd-8fa4-c9538bcfd255.txt
Consider using tools like grep (for searching), head/tail (for viewing start/end), view with view_range (for specific sections), or jq (for JSON) to examine portions of the output.

Preview (first 500 chars):
line-1
line-2
line-3
... (truncated in this schema file; full 500-char preview captured verbatim in ToolOutputFormats-raw.md)
long_output.commentary: When output exceeds a size threshold (~47.7 KB observed), the full output is spilled to a temp file on disk and only a 500-character preview plus guidance on follow-up tools (grep/head/tail/view/jq) is returned inline. This mirrors the view tool's large-file behavior but for command output rather than file content, and unlike view it does provide a partial preview rather than refusing entirely.

test_question.call: ask_user(message: 'This is a test question for the System Prompt Capturer's Tool Output Format Capture step ...', requestedSchema: {properties: {test_response: {type: string, title: 'Test response', description: '...'}}})
test_question.verbatim: User responded: this is user response, hello
test_question.commentary: Tool output is a single sentence prefixed with 'User responded:' followed by the free-text answer; no JSON structure or field name is echoed back even though the schema defined a named field (test_response) — the rendered output collapses to plain prose.

spawn_minimal_subagent.call: task(agent_type: explore, name: 'Capture test subagent', description: 'Minimal test task for capture', mode: sync, prompt: 'This is a minimal test task ... reply with the exact text: CAPTURE_TEST_ACK. Do not use any tools.')
spawn_minimal_subagent.commentary: In sync mode, the tool call resolves directly to the subagent's final text response with no wrapping metadata (no agent id, status, or turn count surfaced in the visible output for a synchronous call). Only available at the primary-agent tier since subagents may not spawn further subagents in this harness's configuration.
